vendor.blurb: Suleyman's in-house MAI team: top-4 image gen in a year, LLMs still catching up

highlights: LMArena text-to-image 1335, #4, behind only three OpenAI models
LMArena image edit 1429, #5, just 1 point behind Grok Imagine 2.0
+79 Elo overall over MAI-Image-2.5, +91 on text rendering
Up to 5 reference images for multi-image editing, with web grounding
mai-image-2.6.notes: Debuted on Arena 8/10; public preview on Foundry 9/4 alongside Flash. Microsoft claims #1 in AA image editing; not independently verified.

mai-image-2.6-flash.tagline: Half the price, last-gen flagship quality
highlights: AA text-to-image 1103, #9, tied with MAI-Image-2.5
Microsoft claims 2.8x the speed of GPT-Image-2 Medium
Priced at roughly half of MAI-Image-2.6
mai-image-2.6-flash.notes: Not yet on the LMArena leaderboard; Foundry bills per token, image output $19 per million tokens.

mai-image-2.5.tagline: The last-gen workhorse that landed in PowerPoint
highlights: LMArena image edit 1400, #7, ahead of Nano Banana Pro
LMArena text-to-image 1254, #12; ranked #3 at launch
AA text-to-image 1103, #10
Integrated into PowerPoint and Foundry
mai-image-2.5.notes: Officially launched at Build 2026 (6/2) with seven MAI models; hit Arena first on 5/26.

mai-image-2.5-pro.tagline: Twice the price, no better score
highlights: AA text-to-image 1099, #12, slightly below standard 2.5
Costs about 2.3x MAI-Image-2.5
mai-image-2.5-pro.notes: Appears only on the AA leaderboard with little official documentation; release date taken from AA.

mai-image-2.5-flash.tagline: The budget tier, already outclassed by 2.6-Flash
highlights: AA text-to-image 1033, #19
2.6-Flash scores 70 points higher at the same price

mai-image-2.tagline: The one that put Microsoft in the top 3
highlights: Ranked #3 on LMArena text-to-image at launch
Now LMArena text-to-image 1184, #21
Powers Copilot and Bing Image Creator
mai-image-2.notes: A faster MAI-Image-2-Efficient is also on Foundry and not listed separately.

highlights: Self-reported AIME 2025 97.0%, AIME 2026 94.5%
SWE-Bench Pro 52.8%, which Microsoft says matches Opus 4.6
Beat Claude Sonnet 4.6 in a 1,276-task blind eval
$2/$8 pricing, aimed at high-volume enterprise use
mai-thinking-1.notes: Build launch was partners only; public preview on Foundry from 8/12. Not on LMArena Text or the AA index; all figures self-reported, benchmarked against the February 4.6 generation.

mai-code-1.1-flash.tagline: A small in-house powerhouse inside Copilot
highlights: 1-Flash has only 5B active parameters; Microsoft benchmarks it against Haiku
1.1 adds native vision: reads screenshots and design mockups
List price 73% lower than MAI-Code-1-Flash
Auto-routed for Copilot Free and student plans
mai-code-1.1-flash.notes: The previous MAI-Code-1-Flash (6/2) was retired from Copilot on 9/10; parameter count follows the 1-Flash figure, as 1.1 hasn't published its own.
